verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions beside a message are a fair capability to ask of an email service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Fastmail offering internal comments, @mentions or side-threads on messages. The pack covers JMAP, filters, templates, snooze, scheduled send, Masked Email and similar features, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
